notes: About: 'Strathberry is an Edinburgh-based global brand specialising in luxury leather goods, founded in 2013 by husband-and-wife team Guy and Leeanne Hundleby. Designed in Scotland, handcrafted in Spain.' Workshops in Ubrique, Spain; signature Music Bar hardware (https://www.strathberry.com/pages/about-us).

US delivery: Standard 3–6 business days free; 2 business days $20; next day $30; 'All US orders are shipped on a delivery duty paid basis' (https://us.strathberry.com/pages/delivery).
